This sauce is true high culinary art.
Oh, the fresh bread fell on the floor.
Right now we will quickly bring you new bread.
No, I am in a big hurry for an important meeting.
But you must taste this rare masterpiece!
I will return at exactly seven o'clock tonight.
We will prepare the very best sauce for you.
Agreed, Viktor, do not let me down tonight.
The Chef never deceives his favorite guests.
Until tonight then, I wish you great work.
We await you in the kitchen with great joy.

the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('important').

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.

meanings.note: Polite (вы) or plural.

examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.

meanings.note: до вечера = until the evening; вечером = in the evening
E.g. a school evening.

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

meanings.note: instrumental of вечер used as an adverb

examples.trans: I'm at home in the evening.

meanings.note: In 'до встречи' = until we meet.

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'you (polite or plural)' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: В гости = for a visit. Abstract feminine noun formed with the Slavic suffix '-ость' ('-ness, -ity') from the corresponding adjective. Common masculine noun meaning 'guest, visitor' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Клавдия Викторовна, к вам гости! Па-пам!
examples.trans: Klavdia Viktorovna, you have visitors! Ta-da!

meanings.note: + genitive.

examples.trans: We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

meanings.note: + genitive.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.en: to agree, to come to an arrangement
meanings.note: 'договоримся' = we'll work something out

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: + accusative.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.note: the thing wished is in the genitive: 'желаю счастья' = I wish you happiness

examples.trans: May we come in? Good day, sir.

examples.text: Ты ещё не понял? Ты теперь знаменитый!
examples.trans: Haven't you understood yet? You're famous now!

meanings.note: Искусство войны = The Art of War.

examples.trans: Read The Art of War, by Sun Tzu!
She loves modern art very much.

meanings.note: connected with cooking or the kitchen

examples.text: Я отличный повар и закончил кулинарный колледж.
examples.trans: I am an excellent cook and finished culinary college.

examples.text: Ладно, сейчас проверим твои настоящие кулинарные навыки.
examples.trans: Fine, now we will test your real culinary skills.

meanings.note: в кухне / на кухне = in the kitchen, на кухню = to the kitchen
E.g. русская кухня. Entered Russian via Polish 'kuchnia' and Middle High German 'küchen', ultimately from Late Latin 'coquina' (from 'coquere', to cook).

examples.trans: And the kitchen is over there.
We are sitting in the kitchen.

examples.text: Проходите, пожалуйста! Как видите, большой коридор, а там кухня.
examples.trans: Come on in, please! As you can see, a big hall, and the kitchen is over there.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world

examples.text: Ты мне даёшь пятьсот рублей, а я выхожу и покупаю тебе лучшую приставку в мире.
examples.trans: You give me five hundred roubles, and I get out and buy you the best console in the world.

examples.text: А ты готовишь мой любимый торт со сгущёнкой!
examples.trans: And you make my favourite condensed milk cake!

examples.text: А ты готовишь мой любимый торт со сгущёнкой! До вечера, Марина.
examples.trans: And you make my favourite condensed milk cake! See you tonight, Marina.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'we' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!

meanings.note: + prepositional: на сайте. Core Russian prep meaning 'on, onto; for' in everyday speech.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

+ genitive. Core Russian part meaning 'no; there isn't' in everyday speech.
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: Stronger contrast than 'а'. Core Russian conj meaning 'but' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('new').

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare
meanings.note: Takes accusative. Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'готовить').

examples.text: Я торт приготовила. Ты любишь сладкое?

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'нести').

meanings.note: 'на работе' = at work. Common feminine noun meaning 'work, job' in everyday Russian.

спешить.gloss: to hurry, be in a rush

meanings.en: to hurry, rush, be in a hurry

meanings.note: At that time. Core Russian adv meaning 'then, back then' in everyday speech.

meanings.note: loaves = хлебы; хлеба = grain crops

examples.trans: The bread is on the table.
